declarations.docstring: Identifies morphisms from a finite biproduct with their component morphisms to the target.
Under the displayed pairing condition, computes the dimension of maps to each member of the target family.
For a projective indecomposable family, relates the displayed algebra predicate to all multiplicities being one.
Uses the stated projective and simple family assumptions to characterize the displayed algebra predicate by unit multiplicities.
Constructs an algebra equivalence from the displayed endomorphism quotient to a family of square matrix algebras.
Under the stated projective and simple family assumptions, constructs the corresponding algebra equivalence to square matrix algebras.
